First obtain a Business Registration Certificate from CAIPO, then submit it along with your business details to the IRD online or in person.
Is there a specific office for Carriacou residents?
Yes, the Carriacou office (see 🏢 Offices tab) serves residents of Carriacou and Petite Martinique.
Can a non-resident register with the IRD?
Yes, non-residents who earn income or conduct business within Grenada can register for a TIN.
I lost my Tax Clearance Certificate.
You need a Tax Clearance Certificate for government tenders, property transfers, work permits, and certain business loans.
How do I correct errors on my registration form?
Correct your details online through your G-TAX account or submit supporting documents to IRD Customer Support to request an update.
